name: Iconic Rides of Pop Culture

questions.question: What is the specific model of the police truck driven by Jim Hopper in Stranger Things?

questions.explanation_incorrect: These are all iconic SUVs from the period, which causes common confusion regarding the Sheriff's exact vehicle.

questions.question: What is the racing vehicle driven by Steve McQueen in the film Le Mans?

questions.explanation_incorrect: The other vehicles were famous competitors in real world endurance racing during that time period, leading to frequent misidentification.

questions.question: What is the name of the car built by Carroll Shelby to defeat Ferrari at Le Mans?

questions.explanation_incorrect: While Shelby had a hand in high-performance modifications for Ford, these specific models were not the 'Le Mans' race winning program.

questions.question: Which mid-sized sedan is regularly used by Fox Mulder in his X-Files field investigations?

questions.explanation_incorrect: These were common fleet vehicles for federal agencies in the 90s, often confused with the Taurus due to similar styling.

questions.question: What does Walter Peck drive when arriving to oversee the shutdown of the Ghostbusters' containment unit?
